title: WHAT IF YOU COULD SWITCH OFF SLEEP?

segments.line: Morning. Mom finds you at the counter.
She asks if you slept. You say, kind of.
Midnight snacks turn into a second dinner.
Pizza at two. Cookies at four.
The cat sleeps most of the day. You sleep none of it.
Your little sister notices too. She's up at six for cartoons,
You put a finger to your lips. Secret.

shots.line: Morning. Mom finds you at the counter.
shots.note: Morning: you at the island, dressed, breakfast out, mug steaming; Mom (white, rose robe, bob) walks in from the right and stops
Breakfast made: plate with eggs and toast, a steaming mug, sliding into frame; a READY tag

shots.line: She asks if you slept. You say, kind of.
shots.note: Mom across the island, worried, leans in: did you sleep? You, smug, shrug: kind of

shots.line: Midnight snacks turn into a second dinner.
shots.note: Midnight: the dark kitchen, you at the island eating, eyes glowing; plates pile up, an open pizza box: SECOND DINNER

shots.line: Pizza at two. Cookies at four.
shots.note: Clock 2:00 next to a pizza slice held up, bites taken; clock flips 4:00, a cookie stack shrinks bite by bite

shots.line: The cat sleeps most of the day. You sleep none of it.
shots.note: The cat curled asleep on the counter in the sun, breathing; ZZZ; 14 HRS tag
The cat opens one eye (peek) at you, unimpressed

shots.line: Your little sister notices too. She's up at six for cartoons,
shots.note: 6:00, your little sister (black, teal pajamas, bunches) shuffles in rubbing her eyes
She looks up: you are already at the island, waving with cereal; she freezes, shock
Every morning: MON / TUE / WED tags flip, you in a new pose each time, she in shock each time
Your sister, eyes narrowed, suspicious: how?

shots.line: You put a finger to your lips. Secret.
shots.note: You put a finger to your lips, cool, eyes glint: Secret
